claims: Lacrosse 26 releases for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Lacrosse 26 features new motion-captured animations for shooting, passing, and dodging.
Lacrosse 26 features commentary from Eamon McAnaney.
Lacrosse 26 is built from the ground up on a new engine.
Lacrosse 26 features improved stick checks, body checks, and dynamic dodging.
The AI in Lacrosse 26 is designed to be more aggressive and capable.
The AI in Lacrosse 26 is designed to reduce reliance on RNG.
Insider Gaming reported that Lacrosse 26 features an in-depth mode likely focused on college lacrosse.
The 2026 NCAA Division I, II, and III Men's Lacrosse Championships will be held in Charlottesville, Virginia.
The National Lacrosse Federation lists top players in the class of 2026, including John Balsamo and Dylan Novak.
